description: This file defines the ResourceIdentifier class which implements interfaces related to JSON API resource identifiers, including managing resource IDs, types, meta information, and associated logging.

classes.name: ResourceIdentifier
classes.description: A class representing a JSON API resource identifier, with properties for id, type, meta, and methods to set and retrieve these properties, as well as to output a JSON API formatted response.

methods.name: withId
methods.description: Sets the ID for the resource and returns a new cloned instance.

methods.name: withType
methods.description: Sets the resource type and returns a new cloned instance.

methods.name: withMeta
methods.description: Associates metadata with the resource identifier and returns a clone.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Assigns a logger instance for the class to use.

methods.name: toJsonApiResponse
methods.description: Generates an array representation of the resource identifier suitable for JSON API responses.
